item.title: Press release: Uber to acquire parking app SpotHero
item.description: 23rd February 2026 – Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: UBER) and SpotHero, Inc. today announced that they have reached an agreement for Uber to acquire SpotHero, bringing parking reservations onto the Uber app. The post Press release: Uber to acquire parking app SpotHero first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: AbbVie to invest $380m in North Chicago to further expand active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing in the United States
item.description: 23rd February 2026 – AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced a new $380 million investment to build two new active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing facilities at its current North Chicago, Illinois, campus. The post Press release: AbbVie to invest $380m in North Chicago to further expand active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing in the United States first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Shamal’s in-house banking shift shows evolution of treasury in the Middle East
item.description: Fast growing regional corporates in the Middle East are increasingly centralising their treasury operations and tapping the benefits of an in-house bank (IHB). Rewards include improved cash and liquidity management and a rationalised banking stack in an iterative process. Shamal, the Dubai-based investment firm, has just completed an overhaul of its treasury function and Treasurer Sleiman El Homsi charts the journey.
